title: Battle target / Stealth / duration / skill quickbar convergence

requirements.summary: Battle Quick Bar validates canonical inner nodes and projects skill name, SP, formal target scope and formal effect text.

Timed buffs, debuffs and hard controls consume on the affected combatant's real action boundary; newly-created effects do not lose the casting action, and intercepted follow-ups do not consume extra turns.
Player, enemy, auto and support target resolution share FourSymbolsBattleSkillTargeting plus FourSymbolsBattlefieldSlots instead of side-specific target-count logic.
Stealth blocks hostile primary selection for normal/single/tri/row/column while allowing range collateral and all-target effects.
Stealthed combatant artwork is 35% opacity while HP/SP/name/status UI stays fully readable.
Late duration restore wrappers, duplicate round-start duration owners and retired V142 support-gameplay ownership are removed from the repaired paths.

notes: main is not modified by this work branch.
DATA_SECURITY_CONTRACTS.md is absent on the base dev and no account/cloud-save/security schema is changed.
